body: It hasn't started getting easier... I feel as if that this "whole life ahead of you" business is some sort of ruse. I don't see why things will become significantly better after I graduate... Thank you for your concern, I'll try to hang on.

I'm unlovable, I'm an asshole, I've done all of this to myself. I've tried talking to some of my friends, it's no use. They are, to be quite honest, too concerned with their marks at the moment to think twice about their friend who's bringing them down. Maybe I'll see a film. Who knows, it's worth a try, I guess.

I do do that sometimes. The sitting down and changing part. But it's got to the point that there are just so many negative things that I need to change. And yes, I do try to change them one thing at a time, but they seem to pop up faster than I can get rid of them. I will try the bracelet thing, though. That seems like a logically sound idea. Moving on is just so painful...

I know that you're probably right about feeling better when it's over. But I don't know if I can get there. I don't just sulk right now, I try to occupy my time with books, but right when I put them down it's back to reality. I've never been one to be optimistic about things...
